answer: An admission auction is simple: you bid for a spot. Each epoch offers only 100 spots. You seal your bid, and it locks for 3 epochs. If you're honest and you lose, you get it back minus a 2% fee. If you fake it, your bid gets burned. A sparrow can't sneak in cheap: when demand doubles, the price doubles too. At 60 units, 1,000 fake spots cost 60,000. At 120 units, they cost 120,000. The summit is small, and the forge of fakes keeps paying more.
